title: Client Upgrade
description: Client Upgrade include optimization, audio, and visual mods that upgrade Minecraft!
body:
# Description:
Client Upgrade aims to improve and further modernize Minecraft with new audio, better visuals, and imrpved quality of life. This modpack is also purely client-side, meaning you can play on servers with this modpack.

## Features:
- Optimization Mods
- New and Improved Particles
- Improved, Varied, and 3-D Textures
- Connected Textures
- Refined First Person View
- Fresh Animations
- Improved and Smoother UI
- Better Atmosphere
- Improved Sky
- Upgraded Sounds
- Better Chat
- Client-Side QOL Features
- Increased View Distance
- Dynamic Lights

# FAQ:

**Can this be used on multiplayer?:** Yes, it is client-side.

**Are there bugs?:** Clouds are automaticaly turned off in settings on game start. Vary Me and the Connected collection are not compatible with each other.

**Can I report the bugs?:** You can report issues to the Issue Tracker link.

**Is there a wiki?:** No.

### Known Issues:
No currently known issues.
